title: Find the Intersection of Two Binary Search Trees
problemStatement: Given the roots of two Binary Search Trees, determine all keys that are present in both trees in sorted order.
input: • The first line contains N₁. • The next N₁ lines describe the first BST. • The following line contains N₂. • The next N₂ lines describe the second BST.
output: • Print all common keys in sorted order.
